notes: PLEA test run 5 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the run-4 code as deployed (launch #1466) plus the fix round and Objection!. Deploy PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. Only PLEA and PleaDistributor take privileged owner arguments, both $owner; PleaLaunch derives its owner from PLEA. CabalGate uses Intake v2 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82, oracle fee asset 0x44a1Cd38474FB1748400E7DEb5F8D786ccE3F89A, TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82, signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. PleaLaunch uses Sepolia v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, the same TestIMD and oracle fee asset, Stacker 0x0457276D7b036818B3EddC1A4A3FCeda61e9314d, credit gas 1300000, START 1792162800 and mintOracleFee = 1 for Sepolia's 0.5 test oracle fee. Its last two arguments commit to keccak256 of this build's argument-free Letterbox and Tribunal creation codes. PLEA.setLauncher accepts the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block; atomic deployment prevents intervening registration. After launch, anyone may deploy the ownerless Letterbox once through PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode) and the ownerless Tribunal once through PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode); both check the committed hash and read their settings from PleaLaunch. PleaHook is deployed separately through PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) with a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt and committed init code. PLEA supply remains zero until that deployment mints the fixed split: 82% to the hook, 6% to Seasons (six seasons of 10000000 PLEA bonus) and 12% to PleaDistributor (the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop, one Merkle root set once by the owner). seed() opens trading for the owner any time or anyone from START. Seasons pay the top 25 wallets with 60 or more points shares of the IMD pot and the PLEA bonus that fall in a straight line from 450 to 350 basis points. Objection!: for 20 minutes after an approval anyone but the seller and the excluded owners may object through the Tribunal (0.5 IMD oracle fee, 0.35 IMD stake); a fresh panel of 30 re-scores the plea reading the gate's own question, the original score and the objection; the recorded score becomes the lowest any panel gave, and the plea earns no points when the new score is more than 2 below its need (sustained, stake back); otherwise the stake goes to the season pot (overruled); a panel with no answer voids the objection and returns the stake; at most two rulings per plea from different wallets, a sustain closes the case; Seasons records a plea only once its window has closed and no objection is pending, and skips held pleas in a close's list; the sale is never touched and rulings never reset the dead-man; the Tribunal verifies attestations under its own EIP-712 domain with the gate's signer. Fix round over run 4: an APPEAL letter of a floor-sized plea is raised to the 0.70 IMD floor (capped at the original amount and 50% of the balance) instead of being refused, and appeals skip the worth-the-fee check; Seasons also excludes the launch owner, read from the hook's owner() with a non-reverting staticcall, while a pending owner is not excluded so a nomination cannot strip a leader; the appeal question states the real previous score and need; judging definitions v3 add under stories that naming the earlier verdict or score in an appeal is not manipulation. Overruled stakes are paid only through permissionless Tribunal.settle; Seasons credits the plea's season, or rollover if it has closed, and checkpoints other donations normally. The two-ruling cap from distinct wallets remains the agreed rule; no PLEA holding or history is required to object.
